offering_description.value: Provides science and engineering consulting, including failure analysis, accident investigation, and product and regulatory risk assessment. Serves corporations, insurers, law firms and government agencies. Delivers work through multidisciplinary teams of scientists, engineers, physicians and regulatory specialists, plus test facilities.

primary_services.value: engineering and scientific consulting; failure analysis and accident reconstruction; product safety and regulatory consulting; health sciences and environmental consulting; human factors and cyber/technology consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations, insurers, law firms, manufacturers, technology and healthcare companies; B2G: federal and state agencies, including safety and regulatory bodies

end_markets.value: consumer products; automotive and transportation; construction and buildings; healthcare and life sciences; energy and chemicals

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly billed consulting, investigation and expert testimony; project or contract: fixed-scope studies, testing and government contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses staff experts and test labs to deliver analysis to corporate, legal, insurer and government clients

geography_served.value: global: US offices nationwide plus offices in Europe, Asia and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: engineering, scientific, health, environmental and technology consulting practices sharing clients and expertise

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: consultants directly engaged by clients and repeat relationships with law firms and insurers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: professional consulting under normal business rules, some professional engineering licensing and expert-witness standards
